name: identity
command: cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime; cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/online; cat /proc/1/wchan; timeout 5 systemctl --failed --no-pager

name: trace
command: ls /sys/kernel/tracing/instances; cat /sys/kernel/tracing/current_tracer /sys/kernel/tracing/set_event; for f in watchdog soft_watchdog softlockup_panic panic; do echo "$f=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/$f)"; done
